answers.core: This feature improves the core user experience for Android export, which is a major use case for Godot users. Having it built into the editor ensures a smoother setup for all users, especially newcomers, and reduces support overhead. It aligns with Godot’s goal of making game development accessible and easy out of the box.
answers.workaround: It is technically possible to write a plugin that automates Android setup, but it would still require manual downloads and path configurations. This is not ideal for beginners, and the process remains confusing and error-prone without deeper knowledge.

title: Add a One-Click Installer for Android Export Requirements in the Editor
